storyCards.headline: Respect Yourself: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Staple Singers's "Respect Yourself" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Respect Yourself" is a song by Luther Ingram and Mack Rice recorded by the American R&B/gospel group the Staple Singers.

Released in late 1971 from their album Be Altitude: Respect Yourself, the song became a crossover hit.

The Staple Singers' version peaked at No.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.
